criteria.requirement: Add explicit Duration pickle reducers preserving original _signature (years/months/weeks/days and fixed components) and object state, reconstructing actual Duration/AbsoluteDuration class. Support all standard pickle protocols, shallow/deepcopy, negatives/zero/microseconds and identical anchor arithmetic; use normalized AbsoluteDuration definition when it has no signature and restore its state. Keep Interval own endpoint reducers and legacy timedelta-style loads untouched. Never load untrusted pickle or change year/month approximate totals.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
